description: Orders a paid report. With an API key that has credit, it is paid at once and generated; otherwise it returns a checkout_url to hand to the human (Stripe), who pays and receives the report by email. Input depends on the product: verifica/bozza need ref (incentive id) and input (business profile + project); piano needs input (questionnaire answers); luogo needs ref (place id); kit needs input.cv, input.role and input.jobs (remote-job ids).

email.description: Email dell'utente che riceverà il report

input.description: Dati per il report (profilo, progetto, risposte, CV)

ref.description: Id della scheda (bando o comune) quando serve

name: create_order
title: Ordina un servizio per l'utente
